text:
maria-marketing: Heads up — proposing a small OSS "Sparklet" microkit launch next Thursday. Goal: get 1) a short tutorial, 2) a benchmark blurb (latency/cost snapshot), and 3) a 30-min demo webinar. Audience = devs trying to add local inference with minimal infra. Thoughts?

devon-devrel: love it. recommend tutorial + 3-minute video gif. keep it copy-first: 'Get local LLM inference in 5 minutes'.

akash-eng: can we commit to benchmark numbers by Wed AM? I can run CPU/gpu microbench on my infra. Need the use-case scripts (inference + caching) to be final.

sam-growth: timeline + CTA: landing page -> demo signups -> follow-up email with quickstart + benchmark PDF. Webinar CTA should push to GitHub star + tutorial.

lily-design: I can mock hero image and 30s GIF. Need final CLI command to record the flow. Prefer we use example: `sparklet run --model small --example chat` in README.

maria-marketing: akash — go for Wed AM. devon — can you draft the tutorial skeleton by Tue EOD? sam — i'll prep the landing page copy + GA events. lily — perfect, we’ll include the GIF in the hero slot and a short embed for the webinar.

devon-devrel: draft plan: 1) quickstart (3 steps), 2) example app (chat + embeddings), 3) benchmark section (table + graph), 4) troubleshooting. Will add code snippet and short video.

akash-eng: quick note on benchmarks: we should include 95th p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k-tokens estimate for both hosted and local (quantized) runs. I'll provide a CSV and a png of the chart.

sam-growth: webinar ask: 30-min format: 10m overview + 10m live demo + 10m Q&A. Hosting: Wed 11am PT or Thurs 9am PT? preference for Thu 9am PT (higher EMEA reach).

lily-design: sample tweet copy: "Ship local inference in minutes with Sparklet — tiny OSS microkit for devs. Join our demo Thurs 9am PT. Demo + benchmark + tutorial -> https://redwood.link/sparklet" Emoji + visual will help.

maria-marketing: Action items: akash (bench CSV + image) — due Wed 9am. devon (tutorial + repo PR) — due Tue 5pm. lily (hero + gif) — Wed noon. sam (landing + webinar page + email flow) — Wed EOD. ops-bot: please create calendar event and PR checklist.

ops-bot: Created calendar event for Sparklet webinar Thu 09:00 PT. Created GitHub issue #sparklet-launch with checklist and assignees: @devon-devrel, @akash-eng, @lily-design, @sam-growth, @maria-marketing.

devon-devrel: I'll open the tutorial PR against `docs/sparklet` once draft is ready, and ping for review.

akash-eng: One more: include a short note on quantization tradeoffs and memory footprint. I'll add a short blurb for the benchmark section.

maria-marketing: Awesome — let's keep comms tight. Will send final launch timeline in this thread tomorrow. Thanks all :tada:
